title: Teaching Salah to Children and the Importance of Early Guidance

text_simplified: Parents must teach their children salah from the age of seven and follow up with them in it. A hadith in Abu Dawud (not in the Sahihayn) instructs teaching children the prayer at seven and striking them over it at ten; the jurists who acted on it restricted it to being light and non-injurious, only after teaching and gradual steps, never resorted to if anything else suffices, away from the face and never in anger. Almorabbi never recommends hitting, but encouragement and follow-up. Children should also be guided toward goodness and gradually accustomed to acts of worship. This text explains the importance of early religious tarbiyah (upbringing).
